[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 07:58  
[USER] User is trying to recreate a Bloody Mary recipe they had at a hotel bar in Miami last month.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on how to make a spicy mix for the Bloody Mary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asked the user to describe the flavor profile of the Bloody Mary they had, including if it was spicy, smoky, tangy, rich, or had unique ingredients or garnishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a basic Bloody Mary mix recipe with the following ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 cups tomato juice (high-quality, low-sodium)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lime juice  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup prepared horseradish  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup hot sauce  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 teaspoon smoked paprika (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Salt and pepper, to taste  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Garnishes: celery stalk, lime wedge, olives, pickle spear, or favorite garnishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided options for adjusting the spiciness of the mix with different types of hot sauce:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Mild: Frank's RedHot or Tabasco (1-2 teaspoons)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Medium: Cholula or Sriracha (2-3 teaspoons)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Hot: Ghost pepper sauce or habanero hot sauce (3-4 teaspoons)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Extremely Hot: Carolina Reaper or Trinidad Moruga Scorpion sauce (1-2 teaspoons, use with caution)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for achieving the perfect spice level, including starting with a small amount of hot sauce and letting the mix sit for at least 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised using high-quality ingredients and experimenting with different types of tomato juice.  
[USER] User asked about the best way to store the spicy mix once it's made and how long it typically lasts in the fridge.  
[USER] User mentioned taking a cocktail-making class a few weeks ago and learning how to make a classic Cosmopolitan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided storage tips for the spicy Bloody Mary mix:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Store in an airtight container  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Keep refrigerated at 40°F (4°C) or below  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Label and date the container
